visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men stand in a brightly lit gym environment. Man A has short blonde hair and is wearing a black T-shirt with the words "TEAM JOINED"; Man B has curly brown hair and is wearing a white T-shirt with a cartoon graphic. They stand beside a Smith machine. Man A gestures towards the barbell while Man B looks on attentively. (2) Man A lifts a black circular weight plate with his right hand and slides it onto the metal barbell of the Smith machine. Man B watches closely, his hands gesturing in a questioning manner. The background features various gym racks, stacked weight plates, and a polished floor under even, bright indoor lighting. (3) Man A adds another weight plate to the stack. Man B's facial expression shifts to one of confusion, looking from the barbell back to Man A. The camera remains static at eye level, capturing the upper bodies and mid-sections of both individuals in a medium shot. (4) Man A flips a third plate and adds it to the bar. Man B gestures more emphatically, his eyes widening in shock. Subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. Man B then begins to touch his lower back and glutes, looking around his body in a comical, confused fashion. (5) Man B bends over significantly, attempting to look back at his own buttocks through his legs. Man A points towards Man B's back with a serious expression, continuing the explanation. The scene ends with Man B maintaining his exaggerated pose while looking toward the camera.
